anime_multiverse.skill.msg.shinra.folded: Devil's Footprints is now part of your Shinra Kusakabe skill.
anime_multiverse.skill.hell_walker.descr: Unique. Shinra Kusakabe of Fire Force, the Devil's Footprints. Wheel: Ignition Dash, Devil's Kick and the Rapid-Man Kick. Your own flames cannot burn you. Toggle Hell Mode: the closer you are to death the harder you hit, with the Devil's Grin under a third of health and Adolla Link when mastered.
anime_multiverse.skill.adolla_burst.desc: Ultimate. Shinra's Ultimate, evolved from Hell Walker. Move at the speed of light striking everything on the way, kick with far more force, unleash the Adolla Burst around you, and in Adolla Link near death a hellfire aura burns the foes around you.
